original.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached children's Unity game talisman sprite to look recognizably like a traditional Korean bujeok, while keeping a simple readable cartoon style, thick dark-brown outline and the tall narrow paper proportions. Current abstract three-branch black mark and brown cardboard are the problem. Replace paper with LIGHT WARM YELLOW-OCHRE parchment (muted golden tan, yellow-dominant three-pigment mixture, NOT chocolate brown). Replace central mark with a DARK VERMILION/RED-BROWN traditional talisman-like brush sigil: vertically arranged angular strokes and hooked strokes, a small squared cap at top, crossed central lines and short outward lower branches, intricate enough to clearly read as a red Korean paper talisman, not a cross, ladder or tree. Red-dominant pigment mixture with a small amount of yellow and blue; clearly reddish brown not black. Preserve crisp bold cartoon readability; not photorealistic. Single upright rectangular paper, front-facing, centered with transparent margins, real RGBA transparency. No external text or labels, no other objects, no shadow, glow or watermark. 1024x1024 square.
original.reason: User correction: recognizable traditional talisman; ochre paper and red-brown sigil, three-primary mixtures retained.
